simple.summary: אַחֲוָה (ʼachăvâh) means solution (of riddles) First listed occurrence: Dan 5 12.

definitions.full: H263. achavah or achavayah [ אַחֲוָיָה ] noun feminine a declaring (properly Infinitive Aph`el, K § 60. 1 )); — construct אֲחִידָן אַחֲוָיַת Dan 5:12 the declaring of riddles (compare הַחִרדָה לְהַגִּיד Judg 14:14 f., Bev).
